title: Ham, apple and Cheddar breakfast loaf

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Butter, eggs, milk, mustard, self-raising flour, apples, cooked ham and Cheddar are all plain kitchen staples.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday item at any mainstream supermarket at a normal price.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a loaf tin, small pan, bowl, grater and a skewer, and the method is simple mixing and baking.

works.reason: The flour, liquid and egg ratios suit a savoury quick bread, and 180°C for 50 to 55 minutes with a skewer test is right for a 900g tin, giving enough slices for four.

honest_times.reason: Grating two apples and the cheese, chopping ham and melting butter fits 20 minutes, and the 55 minute cook matches the bake time.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning, including the thyme, is used in the steps, and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: A warm baked loaf suits late February, and stored apples are named in the title and grated through the whole loaf.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are clear, plain British English with oven temperatures and a doneness test.

hearty_healthy.reason: Ham, eggs, cheese and apple make it a filling breakfast of real food that a family would happily eat again.
